transitions: Transitions are morphs: the last stroke of one image is the first stroke of the next.
labels: Text is written, like the line: a handwriting face (e.g. Caveat) for subtitles, ink at ~84 %, no box, centred near the bottom, written on left to right (~0.2 s + ~17 ms per character) behind a soft paper-coloured halo so passing lines never cross the letters; fade out ~0.45 s. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Titles in a monoline connected script (e.g. Sacramento: itself a one-line drawing), written on in empty paper away from the drawing, gone before the camera moves into them.
motion: Everything on ones (24 fps): the appeal is the continuous act of drawing; stepping breaks it.

Timing = chapter windows + curvature: within a window, time per point is weighted by 1 + K·turn (sharp turns get more time, smoothed so speed never jumps). Pin musical beats with marks: by arc-length fraction or by position ("the second time the pen passes here"). A stop is two marks at the same place.
Corners (speed minima at high turn) can be exported to the soundtrack as candidate note onsets.
Speeds: ~300–700 units/s for travelling lines, ~50–150 for small details. The most important stroke is usually the slowest.

native_moves.name: The pen never lifts
native_moves.does: Anything that is one continuous thing.
native_moves.fits: a river from source to sea; a relay race; a production line.

native_moves.name: The line is time
native_moves.does: The stroke's character changes with age, mood or strain.
native_moves.fits: a building aging; a runner tiring; a machine wearing out.

native_moves.name: Transformation
native_moves.does: One image morphs into the next.
native_moves.fits: a seed becoming a tree becoming a table; a sketch becoming a product; a word becoming its object.

native_moves.name: Stopping is an event
native_moves.does: The nib stops, ink pools, music cuts to silence (1.5–3 s).
native_moves.fits: a power cut; a pause for a minute's silence; a hesitation before a signature.

native_moves.name: Reverse-designed scale reveal
native_moves.does: Every vignette is secretly part of one big picture seen at the end.
native_moves.fits: a city's landmarks forming its skyline; a company's milestones forming its logo; a recipe's steps forming the dish.

native_moves.name: Handoff
native_moves.does: The pen passes to another hand (as a shadow) and a new line begins.
native_moves.fits: a teacher and a student; a founder and a successor; one generation to the next.

native_moves.name: Line as graph
native_moves.does: The line becomes a chart while staying a drawing.
native_moves.fits: a heartbeat; a temperature record; a football match's momentum.

score.note: one solo instrument, one unbroken melodic line
